about: The review of 1.24.17's rules by an agent that had not seen them written (2026-11-13): 313 cases of its own on the history trim (1), CONVERT's unit names (2), the runaway chord line (3), the library's ranking for a named subject (4, worked by hand), the lessons Chat gives (5) and the catalog (6). Each case has what the reviewer expected and got on the build it tried; for rules 2, 5 and 6 also how it comes out now and on 1.24.16. What it found was mended or withdrawn (CHANGELOG 1.24.17); what still differs is either as on 1.24.16 or listed under known.

known.R2: units Lantern has never had: US tablespoon and teaspoon, the dry gallon and bushel, cubic feet, the US survey foot; a plain ton is the metric tonne, as before; a plain pint is not taken as either pint
known.R5: as on 1.24.16 (the scald and the snake bite as Adam's run asked them among them: what reached them was withdrawn)
known.R6: harvesting rainwater, power plants, plants in medicine list Farming, as on 1.24.16
known.R3: a chord line whose last bar differs (a real ending) is read as cut off; an AABA form of 32 bars is no cycle of 16 or fewer, and is left as before
known.R4: worked by hand; the bonus now needs 'the <what> of <name>' in the asking sentence, or a title that is the name and question words only: the surname, Kenya and Texas cases get none
